checks.finding: RNC16 matches the whole literal original CNR3: fixed imaginary quadratic K, then c,A, then e,N,p,w and the finite indexed root-of-unity orbit, then NN, then every odd coefficient prime including 3, closure, scalar tower, fixed iota, prolongation, arithmetic Frobenius and pairwise-nonisomorphic collection. Both original Adm3 and Adm2 alternatives remain. Repeated orbit values retain their indices; empty families are included.

RNC1 is the single new class-A checked application. General regular-algebraic polarized Galois existence precedes weight identification; full coefficient-prime compatibility is used only at the checked Shin-regular weights. The classical-input registry keeps CM versus totally real, geometric-Frobenius, Hodge-sign and all-prime scopes explicit. No stronger all-rank CountK/CountQ, all-prime irreducibility or unrelated local correspondence theorem is inferred.

The auxiliary levels N^5 and (N|disc K|)^3 bound full automorphic labels without replacing the original Galois levels. The local LevelAt disjunction controls monodromy rather than inserting a new coefficient-prime factor. Full cusp labels and all-Aut(C) conjugation precede the later coefficient datum. The integer-power Satake formula removes any need for complex automorphisms to fix a chosen square root.

PGK1–6 prove the entire finite implication CNR3 and OneChar imply PropGK. The separate original OneChar is explicitly supplied, including finite original Selmer length and its finite trace/valuation sum. PGK6 handles all number fields, with an impossible-GD branch outside the imaginary quadratic case. The integer precedes every later coefficient ring; prime 3 is retained with the original GD guard, and no new coefficient extension or cross-character nonisomorphism assumption is introduced.

The original CNR3 producer and TASK_PROP_GK_INSTALL implication task are the only selected whole obligations closed. The latter was already classified as an implication-reconstruction task in v0.45; completing it does not supply OneChar, RIG_II, unconditional PropGK or Case I. The final audit and continuation state this distinction consistently.

ARO uses the original adelic SG.HidaSetting, not the previously completed ordinary-Hecke setting. Actual reduction, both conjugate orientations, exact kernel and surjectivity, Haar-fiber volume V, the original additive character and full event algebra are proved on supplied original data. The chosen good rows, repeated labels, formal degrees and quotient measure are preserved in one AllRows/AllJoinA/PCountTie object before events vary.

RowsFinDim, GapHyp and original AutTie/RowDictTie/LabTie remain explicit. ARO28 retains exact CountIdempotentsClass; ARO29 retains normalized-type compatibility, TieAdmG, RangeW and FLC19's actual-rank/eventual guard. ARO30 requires one common family and simultaneous threshold before all varying members. Neither the common setting nor the arithmetic cylinder counts are inferred from the finite row construction; GLOBAL_RETAINED_DEFECT remains open.

ICL8 concerns the whole original valuation-nonnegative cusp lattice at every original weight. Its finite separating evaluations are integral at every finite prime of a single good model; ramified Lie eigenmodules are full saturated kernels, with no integral direct-sum claim. Scalar-extension injectivity uses the original reduced test algebras. No spanning, a priori saturation of the cusp lattice or merely bounded-denominator substitute is assumed.

The identity cover is exact only given the original IsNab connection. Full spanning additionally retains the actual principal-chart, level-system, raw Gaussian/reproduction, short-rule/gluing/dictionary and ramified-jet groups, uniformly at every original row and required weight. These original unreconstructed producers are not reclassified as published foundations. The supplied CM/abelian-scheme/fixed-type finite-dimensionality foundations are separately named.

The conditional Neumann/unfolding, finite harmonic span, original-field descent and one-scalar all-place denominator arguments retain the actual free lattice/frame action, original metric, measure and phases. ICL19–21 give exact conditional FullAt/LatFull and FWTie transport to both original Boolean MLat levels. Higher CoversAt, all-tuple class sums/uniqueness with phase rescalings, one PointIdentCore before all tuples, base ClassSumsSpan, common family existence, Fits and eta agreement remain open.

GLG7 and GLG9 match the complete original RestStar and RemainingCountingStatement, including the constant chosen before the instance families, both candidate-prime ranges, all later members and lifts, arbitrary original top weights without an upper bound, and the exact error b_o=b^(x^(-epsilon/2)) with coefficient one. The original AdmFam antecedent is retained; its existence is not a consequence of the counting theorem.

GLG13–15 retain both original integral representation models, actual coefficient-rational evaluations, the original comparison extension and exact finite-intersection descent. The normalized local length divides by v_O(p)=a_w e_w, matching the original A-length divided by e_w. No Galois-extension or unrecorded flatness assumption is introduced into the comparison consumer.

GLG17 supplies all five literal LinkG_at fields with the same objects and constant 4|C|+1. GLG18 retains actual GroupCompatibilityFamily or its precise NPDescF consequence, full AdmFam including every admG1 clause and original first growth, and eventual MeanKappaBound. GW2 is available only with its actual guards; mere nonnegativity is not asserted to supply mean deficit. GLOBAL_LOCAL_GAIN and the other quantitative whole obligations remain open.

Direct comparison preserves all 121 selected nodes and all 161 requires edges. Exactly CNR3 and TASK_PROP_GK_INSTALL leave the register. All 28 remaining category/kind/status fields are unchanged. DESIGN_CHOICES_COMMON and BASE_THETA_RATIONAL_TESTS retain their entire previous contract verbatim and append only the explicit ICL progress/boundary; every other selected contract is unchanged. The remaining inventory is 20 C plus 8 B, with 21 shared RH/GRH, 7 additional Dirichlet-GRH and no RH-only entry.

The six-field same-J Hida result, actual LevelAlt/HasAut, both selected rank-four support Links, finite local weights, host rigidity and adjoint leaves remain completed at their existing scopes. The current roadmap does not reopen them or restore Case II. RH retains Cases I/V and OneChar/RIG_II; unrestricted Dirichlet GRH retains its separate Case III, Seed IV and rank-four chain branch.
